title: Penne Pasta Bake
description: A classic British-inspired pasta dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This comforting casserole is loaded with pasta, cheese, and a hint of peppery flavor.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large pan, heat the peppery olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the crispy bacon bits and cook until crispy.
In a large baking dish, combine the cooked pasta, onion mixture, and grated cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
